resources.string: Get alerts when you are offline
Reminds you to go online when you have been offline
Go online to start receiving orders.
Enter a number of minutes between 1 and 1440
While you are offline and this is ON, you get a notification with a sound at this interval. It stops as soon as you go online. In battery saver mode a reminder can come a little late.
Notifications are switched off for this app. Turn them on in phone Settings to get offline alerts.
